d:
Patna ke gandhi maidan men bihar draivar esosieshan ke hajaron draivar jute hain. 10 sutri mangon ko lekar draivron ne mukhyamantri aavas tak march karne ka ailan kiya hai. aakhir draivron ki kya hain mangen aur sarkar se kyon naraj hain? dekhie yah riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
